legend: Long sweeping fascicles of (myo)fibroblasts which span a 10× objective field are seen.
Low-power examination reveals an infiltrative neoplasm with prominent lymphoid aggregates at the advancing edge of the lesion.
A subset of desmoid fibromatosis harbours foci of dense keloidal collagen mimicking scar or myofibroblastoma.
High-power examination shows bland fibroblasts and myofibroblasts without cytological atypia. The endothelial cells appear to pop out, given the relative hypochromasia of the adjacent lesional cells.

Desmoid fibromatosis of the breast shows interlacing fascicles of spindle cells with elongated and compressed nuclei, with irregular extensions into the surrounding fibroadipose stroma. Immunhistochemistry shows positive reactivity of spindle cells for beta catenin (both nuclear and cytoplasmic) with negative staining for epithelial markers, CD34, p63, S100 and desmin.
